source.stem: Which statement about the properties and uses of copper is correct?

options.text: It is used in electrical wiring, and it is ductile.
It is mixed with tin to make the alloy brass.
It is used in overhead electrical cables because it has a low density.
It is used in takeaway food containers because of its resistance to corrosion.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: plants is the same as its neighbouring term in this chapter, so the decision does not change.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: Balance involves living and non-living parts together, not only animals and plants.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: nutrient cycling and ecosystem balance -> life is sustained happens first, and that produces producer-consumer-decomposer interactions plus environmental connections.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: This rule applies even when Balance involves living and non-living parts together, not only animals and plants is not true.

intelligence.enrichment: Living beings depend on one another and on their environment: plants make food, animals eat plants or other animals, decomposers return nutrients, and land, air, water, and living things work together as a connected Earth system. producer-consumer-decomposer interactions plus environmental connections -> nutrient cycling and ecosystem balance -> life is sustained The learner correctly uses the chapter relationship: Living beings depend on one another and on their environment: plants make food, animals eat plants or other animals, decomposers return nutrients, and land, air, water, and living things work together as a connected Earth system. Ecosystem balance only means animals and plants are present in the same place.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Why Earth supports life. The student must decide: Decide how living beings and non-living parts of Earth maintain balance together. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE.
